mapper.sql: h.id, h.subscription_id, h.work_id, h.kind, h.created, h.names::text AS names, h.digest_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hit (subscription_id, work_id, kind, names) VALUES (#{o.subscriptionId}, #{o.workId}, #{o.kind}, COALESCE(#{o.names, typeHandler=org.catalogueoflife.garrulus.store.type.JsonbStringTypeHandler}, '[]'::jsonb)) ON CONFLICT (subscription_id, work_id, kind) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT FROM hit h WHERE h.subscription_id = #{subscriptionId} AND h.work_id = #{workId} AND h.kind = #{kind}

SELECT FROM hit h JOIN subscription s ON s.id = h.subscription_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND NOT s.paused AND h.digest_id IS NULL AND h.created > #{since} AND h.created >= #{minCreated} ORDER BY h.created DESC, h.id DESC
mapper.update:
UPDATE hit SET digest_id = #{digestId} WHERE digest_id IS NULL AND
false id = ANY(#{hitIds, typeHandler=org.catalogueoflife.garrulus.store.type.LongListTypeHandler})
UPDATE hit SET digest_id = NULL WHERE digest_id = #{digestId}
UPDATE hit h SET work_id = #{toWork} WHERE h.work_id = #{fromWork} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM hit t WHERE t.work_id = #{toWork} AND t.subscription_id = h.subscription_id AND t.kind = h.kind)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM hit h WHERE h.subscription_id = #{subscriptionId} ORDER BY h.created DESC, h.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
